title: Posting of project information panels.
officialText:
A project information panel shall be posted on the fence on each
perimeter fronting a public thoroughfare. Where such perimeter is more than 150 feet in length, a project information panel
shall be posted at each corner. Such panels shall be posted on the fence at a height of 4 feet (1219 mm) above the ground,
with such distance measured from the ground to the bottom edge of the panel.
